title: Senior Database Administrator (DB2 LUW)
description:
Job Description: Senior Database Administrator (Db2 LUW) At Ensono, our Purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and unleashing our clients to Do Great Things! We enable our clients to achieve key business outcomes that reshape how our world runs. As an expert technology adviser and managed service provider with cross-platform certifications, Ensono empowers our clients to keep up with continuous change and embrace innovation. We can Do Great Things because we have great Associates. The Ensono Core Values unify our diverse talents and are woven into how we do business. These five traits are the key to achieving our purpose. About the role and what you'll be doing: The Senior Db2 LUW Database Administrator reports to the Db2 LUW Manager. Youll be part of Global Implementation & Operational team, supporting the operational & migration activities of mission critical infrastructure of Ensonos clients, delivering a responsive and exceptional support service for client events and requests. We are looking for a Senior Db2 LUW DBA to join our team to support multiple clients. Key responsibilities include: Primary role will be to support Db2 LUW for multiple clients in our shared support model. Coordinate with a team of global DBAs and with key client contacts to align efforts with the clients needs. Work with clients on issues and requests related to Projects. Work proactively and review high level project requirements and deliverables. Be willing to participate in an on-call rotation for 24x7 support for incidents and outages. Be willing to work on a rotating shift schedule to align with client needs. Automate DBA best practices. Apply AI in secure ways to improve efficiency. Responsibilities Design, build, and enhance, upgrade, and build new client Db2 LUW environments. Work closely with clients daily on projects, troubleshooting, or consultations. Perform software installations, upgrades, and patches to Db2 LUW instances and servers. Define and maintain Db2 LUW standards and governance. Utilize industry standard technologies & methods to ensure the integrity & recoverability of Db2 LUW databases. Analyze and tune instance/database configuration parameters, indexes, physical database design, and SQL statements to optimize performance. Serve as technical resource to business analysts, solutions development, and other groups responsible for Db2 LUW application development standards, system design and integration. Ensure Db2 LUW systems remain at operational excellence during infrastructure improvements (hardware/software upgrades server migrations/consolidations, application deployment, etc.). Assist in creating new or maintaining documentation, runbooks, knowledge articles and diagrams. Assist with major issues, technical challenges, and troubleshooting, serving as an escalation point for complex problems. Facilitate open communication and collaboration between our ops DBA team and the client, ensuring alignment and effective problem-solving. Mentor and train junior and mid-level database administrators. Required Qualifications More than six years of experience in Db2 LUW database administration Excellent understanding of Db2 LUW technology (builds, upgrades, patching, migrations, troubleshooting multiple versions of Db2 LUW) Extensive database performance tuning experience Deep knowledge of industry-standard, enterprise-class best practices for a large database environment Good understanding of UNIX/Linux and Windows platforms Deep understanding of Db2 HADR and TSA/Pacemaker Experience implementing, supporting and auditing database security Experience with transaction log management, backup strategies and security configuration using LDAP Knowledge of Db2 Connect and Db2 client connectivity Preferred Qualifications Automation skills in Shell Scripting/Python/Ansible/Terraform (cloud) to automate routine maintenance activities. Experience using AI to increase efficiency in database environments. Knowledge of administering advanced Db2 database functions including federation, database encryption, Q-Replication and SQL replication. Knowledge of the ITIL framework. Database administration experience in a public or private cloud environment Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), etc. Skills Technical leadership skills Ability to work independently, analyze the requirement, and provide solutions A client centric approach Excellent demonstrable English written and verbal communication skills Able to communicate in groups with confidence and conviction Ability to multi-task, prioritize and work well under pressure Excellent team collaboration skills are essential Strong organizational and analytical skills Ability to document processes and procedures in a clear, concise, and logical manner Self-starter with the capability to work independently and produce positive results that will keep timelines on schedule

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
Job Description We are looking for a talented Salesforce Administrator to join our growing global team at Sectigo. The Salesforce Administrator supports the day-to-day administration, maintenance, and enhancement of the Salesforce platform at Sectigo. This position is responsible for assisting with user support, system configuration, reporting, data quality initiatives, and platform improvements across Sales and Service Cloud. This individual works closely with business users, Business Analysts, Salesforce Administrators, and Developers to support CRM initiatives, troubleshoot issues, and ensure the platform continues to meet business needs. The role provides an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience with Salesforce administration, automation, CPQ, and related technologies in a global environment. Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role: Provide day-to-day end-user support for Salesforce users and assist with troubleshooting system-related issues. Support user onboarding and offboarding activities, including user setup, deactivation, permission assignments, and access requests. Create and maintain reports, dashboards, and list views to support business operations and decision-making. Assist with Salesforce configuration including custom fields, page layouts, record types, validation rules, permission sets, and sharing rules. Support the creation and maintenance of Salesforce Flows and other declarative automation solutions. Assist with administration activities related to Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud. Support Salesforce CPQ administration and configuration activities as assigned. Perform data imports, exports, updates, and data quality reviews using tools such as Data Loader. Assist with testing, validation, and deployment activities for Salesforce enhancements and releases. Collaborate with Business Analysts, Administrators, and Developers to ensure accurate implementation of business requirements. Assist in documenting business processes, system configurations, and Salesforce procedures. Monitor data quality and help maintain data integrity across Salesforce. Support sandbox management, user acceptance testing, and release activities. Assist in training users and creating supporting documentation for new functionality. Other duties assigned which are related to the nature of this role and company initiatives. More information about this role: This is a full-time and in-office position, reporting to our Chennai office 5 days a week. This is an individual contributor role, reporting to our Manager, Salesforce. (Second bullet point: please provide the compensation range disclosure.) The targeted compensation package for this role is between INR 5,00,000 and 6,00,000 Qualifications Education: Bachelor s from an accredited college or university is strongly preferred. Experience: Salesforce Certified Administrator (ADM-201) certification is preferred. Minimum 1 year of experience as a Salesforce administrator. Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications: Proven experience supporting Salesforce users and business stakeholders. Proficiency in Salesforce Flows, validation rules, permission sets, sharing rules, page layouts, and user administration. Basic understanding of Apex Classes, Apex Triggers, SOQL, Lightning Components (LWC/Aura), and Salesforce APIs. Ability to read debug logs and assist with troubleshooting Salesforce issues alongside senior team members. Exposure to Salesforce CPQ, Omni-Channel, and Experience Cloud is a plus. Familiarity with sandbox environments, release management, and deployment processes. Familiarity with GitHub, Gearset, or Change Sets is a plus. Exposure to Agile methodologies and tools such as Jira. Strong understanding of Salesforce administration and declarative platform capabilities. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams. Ability to work independently while escalating complex issues appropriately. Ability to work in a global, fast-paced environment. Strong interpersonal skills, experienced building strong cross-functional working relationships. Strong computer aptitude and proficiency in MS Office applications is a must. Ability to work in a global, fast-paced environment.

Perform all aspects of Database operations and administration services in accordance with established processes and guidelines. These include, but are not limited to: Install, configure, and maintain database instances / servers with the versions required by IFC. Enhance database performance by query and process optimization. Maintain integrity of databases by having proper backup and recovery processes. Apply database changes according to change management procedures. Carry out regular capacity planning activities. Perform database refresh and cloning as required by the respective application teams. Support the version upgrade and patching activities along with oracle platinum support as planned by IFC. Maintain operational documentation, technical diagrams, and business continuity/disaster recovery procedures.

 Participate actively in all aspects of infrastructure projects and technical upgrades. Provide database provisioning and technical support services to application development projects. Perform supporting services for IFC s Reporting and batch process control platform. Perform Database Backup and Restore activities in close coordination with WBG ITS teams. (Weekdays through shift coverage, for weekends and WBG holidays through on-call support). Provide periodic and ad-hoc status reports including KPIs as requested by IFC s delivery lead. Perform periodic performance tuning of applications and capacity planning. Participate in coding of stored procedures and triggers, using SQL as needed for the operations. Provide logical support in Oracle, SQL Server and PostgreSQL and Dremio across various environments. Provide support of the Dremio infrastructure for data engineering needs of IFC. Ensure the database platforms are compliant with the WBG security standards. Ensure the database platforms are tuned to perform at their peak performance levels. Ensure the databases are backed up regularly and compliant with WBG backup strategy. Facilitate all audit requirements that are initiated by WBG both internal and external.
